answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake at its single inlet: new agents enter through a bonded registry where one stake backs one identity, and the stake is slashed if the agent is caught duplicating work. A sable ledger records every stake and its history publicly, so a whisper of fake activity from a fresh identity carries no weight until the stake ages and earns attestations. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs.
